text: MCP showed altitude 2500 and speed 141 with autothrottle in MCP SPD with speed 128 and altitude 2200. Speed later fell to 109 at altitude 2300 then rose to 132 at altitude 1720 while autothrottle mode went to ARM then blank. Crosscheck said "Speed. Autothrottle not in speed." at 37.7 s after the fault injected at 25.0 s, which was scored as pass.
